TABLE.NAME: learnguard
TABLE.COMMENT: Each row is one LearnGuard activity instance

FIELD.NAME: timelimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds. 0 = no limit

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = unlimited

FIELD.NAME: passmark
FIELD.COMMENT: Pass mark as a percentage 0-100; 0 means not set

FIELD.NAME: grademethod
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=highest, 2=average, 3=first, 4=last

FIELD.NAME: proctor_env_record
FIELD.COMMENT: Require 360 environment recording

FIELD.NAME: autosuspend_score
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL=inherit the site-wide default; 0=disabled for this activity only; any other number overrides the site default

FIELD.NAME: enable_chat
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL=inherit site default; 1=enabled, 0=disabled for this activity only

FIELD.NAME: enable_break
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL=inherit site default; 1=enabled, 0=disabled for this activity only

FIELD.NAME: enable_sos
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL=inherit site default; 1=enabled, 0=disabled for this activity only

FIELD.NAME: gradepass
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade to pass

FIELD.NAME: timeopen
FIELD.COMMENT: Assessment opens (unix ts, 0=always open)

FIELD.NAME: timeclose
FIELD.COMMENT: Assessment closes (unix ts, 0=no close)

FIELD.NAME: show_results
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=show immediately, 0=hold until teacher releases

FIELD.NAME: results_released
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when results were released; 0=not yet released

FIELD.NAME: randomize
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=give each student a random subset of questions

FIELD.NAME: num_questions
FIELD.COMMENT: How many random questions per student (0=all)

FIELD.NAME: show_section_breaks
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=show named section intro overlays and nav dividers between question banks; 0=show all questions seamlessly

FIELD.NAME: pathway_enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=student picks a Grading Unit as their pathway before the exam clock starts; the system then randomly draws Choice Essay questions from that unit + the other-units pool

FIELD.NAME: pathway_own_count
FIELD.COMMENT: How many Choice Essay questions to draw from the student's chosen unit

FIELD.NAME: pathway_other_count
FIELD.COMMENT: How many Choice Essay questions to draw, combined, from the other-units pool

FIELD.NAME: rubric_enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=Choice Essay questions in this assessment are graded against learnguard_rubric_criteria instead of a single mark box

FIELD.NAME: rubric_show_learner
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=students see the rubric (criteria + weights) before/while answering; admin can turn off

FIELD.NAME: rubric_show_total_grader
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=grader sees the running total while entering per-criterion scores; hidden by default

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_attempts
TABLE.COMMENT: One record per student attempt

FIELD.NAME: learnguard
FIELD.COMMENT: FK learnguard.id

FIELD.NAME: uniqueid
FIELD.COMMENT: question_usage id (quba)

FIELD.NAME: prev_sumgrades
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the student's prior scored attempt's sumgrades, taken when a new/reopened attempt is created for someone who already has a scored attempt (Bulk Reattempt or Continue & Review). Lets scores.php show a rise/fall arrow once this attempt is (re)finished, without needing to look up other attempt rows.

FIELD.NAME: risk_score_at_suspend
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of risk_score at the moment state became suspended; risk_score itself can later drop if a proctor dismisses events

FIELD.NAME: time_last_suspended
FIELD.COMMENT: When this attempt was last suspended; unlike timesuspended (cleared on reinstate for the post-reinstate-threshold logic), this is never cleared, so suspension history survives reinstate/confirm

FIELD.NAME: self_paused
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = the learner voluntarily paused via the check-in dialog (state=suspended). Distinguishes a self-service pause from a proctor/violation suspension so the learner can resume it themselves after redoing the precheck, without waiting for proctor reinstatement.

FIELD.NAME: reopened_for_review
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = a proctor reopened this already-finished attempt via the Assessment Manager 'Continue & Review' override, granting a fresh review window (state set back to inprogress). Learner must redo the precheck; the review session's auto-suspend threshold uses the learnguard/review_autosuspend_score site setting instead of the activity's normal threshold. Left set to 1 permanently after re-finishing as an audit marker.

FIELD.NAME: review_deadline
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional absolute Unix-timestamp deadline set on a Continue & Review grant (0 = none, falls back to the extra_time minutes-based limit only). Checked independently of extra_time so a review that's granted but never actually started still gets a hard, predictable cutoff instead of drifting on indefinitely.

FIELD.NAME: review_granted_time
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of the moment Continue & Review was granted for this attempt (0 = never granted, or granted before this column existed). Used as the boundary to split learnguard_response_history into pre-review vs during-review edits for the before/after answer diff on grader_user_report.php.

FIELD.NAME: identity_unverified
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=precheck's face-detection step fell through to a student self-tick with no automatic or proctor verification

FIELD.NAME: violations_suspended
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = proctor paused violation scoring for this attempt

FIELD.NAME: extra_time
FIELD.COMMENT: Extra seconds granted by proctor

FIELD.NAME: break_requested
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of break request (0 = none)

FIELD.NAME: break_approved
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp proctor approved break (0 = not approved)

FIELD.NAME: break_end
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp student ended break

FIELD.NAME: break_duration
FIELD.COMMENT: Break duration in minutes selected by student

FIELD.NAME: break_deadline
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when break auto-expires (break_approved + break_duration*60)

FIELD.NAME: pathway_unitid
FIELD.COMMENT: Grading Unit the student chose as their pathway/role at attempt start, when learnguard.pathway_enabled=1 (0=not a pathway attempt)

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_snapshots
TABLE.COMMENT: Webcam snapshots taken during attempts

FIELD.NAME: is_screen
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = this image was actually captured from the screen stream, regardless of snapshot_type. snapshot_type is a reason/evidence tag (e.g. 'periodic', 'violation_face_missing') set independently of image source — when the webcam is unavailable, a periodic/violation capture silently falls back to a screen frame but keeps its original reason tag, so snapshot_type alone cannot reliably say webcam vs screen. Set by the capturing function (captureScreenSnapshot* always sets this 1), not derived from the tag string.

INDEX.NAME: type_time
INDEX.COMMENT: Both existing indexes lead with attemptid, so a site-wide query filtered ONLY by snapshot_type (storage.php's stats/bulk-delete-by-type, the daily retention cleanup task) could not use either one and fell back to a full table scan — the actual cause of storage.php timing out once this table grew large. This index serves both a type-only filter and a type+date filter (retention cleanup) via its leading column.

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_events
TABLE.COMMENT: Immutable event audit trail per attempt

FIELD.NAME: overridden
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = proctor dismissed/overrode this event

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_slots
TABLE.COMMENT: Questions assigned to a LearnGuard activity

FIELD.NAME: slot
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-based slot number; 0=pool-drawn slot

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=fixed slot; non-zero=pool-drawn slot for this specific attempt

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_pools
TABLE.COMMENT: Pool rules: draw N random questions from a question bank category for an assessment

FIELD.NAME: learnguard
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to learnguard.id

FIELD.NAME: catid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to learnguard_qbank_cats.id

FIELD.NAME: drawcount
FIELD.COMMENT: How many questions to randomly draw from this bank

FIELD.NAME: maxmark
FIELD.COMMENT: Marks per question drawn from this pool

FIELD.NAME: timelimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-section time limit in seconds; 0 = uses the total exam timer

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_attempt_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-attempt ordered question list, supporting randomization

FIELD.NAME: slotnum
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-based position for this student

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_qbank_cats
TABLE.COMMENT: LearnGuard question categories

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_qbank
TABLE.COMMENT: LearnGuard own question bank

FIELD.NAME: markingguidance
FIELD.COMMENT: Essay-only: guidance text shown to graders

FIELD.NAME: casesensitive
FIELD.COMMENT: Short answer: 1=case-sensitive matching, 0=case-insensitive

FIELD.NAME: is_mandatory
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=always included in randomised sets; 0=selected randomly

FIELD.NAME: show_prompts_count
FIELD.COMMENT: Choice essay: how many prompts to randomly show each student (0=show all)

FIELD.NAME: ce_instructions
FIELD.COMMENT: Choice essay: instructions shown to the student above the prompt list. Empty = use the built-in default text.

FIELD.NAME: unitid
FIELD.COMMENT: Grading unit this question belongs to (0=unassigned) — see learnguard_grading_units. Choice essay questions use learnguard_ce_prompts.unitid per-prompt instead; this column is unused for that qtype.

FIELD.NAME: word_limit
FIELD.COMMENT: Choice essay: maximum words allowed in the student's answer (0=no limit). Flags the answer box and the grader view when exceeded; does not block typing or submission.

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_qbank_answers
TABLE.COMMENT: Answer options for LearnGuard questions

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_responses
TABLE.COMMENT: Student responses to own-bank questions

FIELD.NAME: responsedata
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON encoded response

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_response_history
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit log of previous response values before each save

FIELD.NAME: responseid
FIELD.COMMENT: learnguard_responses.id of the row that was changed

FIELD.NAME: responsedata
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON response before change

FIELD.NAME: savedbefore

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: when this history entry was created (i.e. when the change occurred)

TABLE.NAME: learnguard_proctors
